entries.message: Fix - Show real episode names on watched shows and polish the Up Next rail
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Show real episode names on watched shows and polish the Up Next rail

Fix: Dashboard and history episode cards now use the actual episode name stored on the watch record; watches received from a media server as only a coordinate ("S1E5") get the real name resolved from stored metadata at ingest so the card never falls back to a placeholder

Fix: Database Repairs gains a Restore Missing Episode Names tool that backfills a real episode name onto watch rows that only stored a coordinate (audit shows affected rows first; restore resolves stored data then a metadata lookup when needed)

Fix: The Up Next rail no longer paints the same next-up episode twice and stops wrongly merging re-releases/reboots that share a title but aired in a different year; removing a tile now animates it out before an overlapping refresh repaints

entries.message: Feature - Simplify rating and watchlist sync to one toggle and fix Plex watchlist delivery
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Simplify rating and watchlist sync to one toggle and fix Plex watchlist delivery

Feature: Personal Rating Sync and Personal Watchlist Sync each collapse to a single on/off control that syncs two-way with every connected Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and Trakt account, with Plembfin as the conflict authority and a safe first-run union an empty provider snapshot cannot erase

Feature: Watchlist sync now explains anything a service refuses instead of only saying attention is needed: a refused sign-in names the service and links to its connection settings, a rejected change shows the provider's own error and when the next attempt is due, and a title missing from an Emby or Jellyfin library is reported as expected rather than a fault, with a Retry queued changes button

Feature: Fixed Plex watchlist sync end to end: reading the watchlist, resolving a title, adding, and removing all used endpoints Plex does not serve, so nothing reached Plex and additions made there were never imported into Plembfin

Feature: Fixed the app freezing for up to a minute at a time, which also dropped the background scheduler and stalled every page: building the dashboard Up Next rail blocked the whole server and now completes in under a second

Feature: Metadata is warmed in the background as media is discovered through library webhooks and provider Up Next feeds, so dashboards and detail pages stay cache-first instead of downloading during a request
Feature: Up Next cards gained Remove from up next, which dismisses the item through each provider's own native endpoint and clears local progress
Feature: Episode cards no longer route through episode-level provider ids, so a deep link from a card opens the correct show instead of an unrelated one
Feature: Discover, Watchlist, Ratings, Custom Lists, and History now use the compact poster-first card geometry at mobile widths

entries.message: Fix - Make Now Playing update faster and prevent false "stopped" readings
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Make Now Playing update faster and prevent false "stopped" readings
Fix: Now Playing reflects a session starting or ending within seconds instead of up to a minute later
Fix: Plex sessions update instantly by reusing the existing live connection to Plex, adding no extra load
Fix: Opening the dashboard or returning to a background tab refreshes Now Playing immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check
Fix: Fixed a bug where a single failed check against Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin could wrongly mark a still-playing session as stopped and record it as partially watched
Fix: Fixed a bug where Plex switching video quality mid-playback could trigger the same false "stopped" misdetection

entries.message: This update includes sync activity retries resolve in place and dashboard posters stop flickering, make onboarding less text-heavy and stop requiring a media server, and center the setup wizard and move Restore from backup into its own card.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Sync activity retries resolve in place and dashboard posters stop flickering

Fix: Retrying a failed or skipped sync item now updates its status in place instead of leaving a stale duplicate error entry behind - it shows success, or skipped when there's nothing configured to sync to, instead of staying stuck as failed forever

Fix: Added a Retry all failed action on the Sync Activity page that retries every failed or skipped item across the whole history, not just the current page, as a background job that keeps running even if you close the tab or navigate away
Fix: Fixed the Sync Activity Retry failed button giving no visible feedback when a retry finished or failed
Fix: Fixed unconfigured media servers being dispatched to and reported as errors instead of being skipped the same way a disabled server already is
Fix: Fixed dashboard posters flickering and reloading in the Continue Watching row whenever a playing item's resume progress updated
Fix: Make onboarding less text-heavy and stop requiring a media server
Fix: Setup wizard step tabs are now evenly spaced across the full width instead of clustered to the left
Fix: Shortened the overview step's intro text and each card's description, and centered the intro

Fix: Media servers are no longer required to finish setup - manually marking titles watched works without one; the overview card, Review step, and sidebar reminder reflect this instead of blocking completion
Fix: Fixed cramped spacing between the TMDB card's Required and Configured badges on the Metadata step
Fix: Center the setup wizard and move Restore from backup into its own card
Fix: Bulk and single episode watch dates now follow runtime spacing and directional labels.

Fix: Stopped fetching every season's episode list before a show's detail page could render, which held the loading screen up for 10+ seconds on shows with many seasons; other seasons now load in the background as they're expanded, with a proper loading indicator instead of a misleading "no episodes found" message
Fix: Split the Born/From details on the cast bio page into separate lines instead of repeating the person's age twice, and removed the duplicate age next to their name
Fix: Resized the bio page's IMDb/Instagram/X/Facebook/TikTok/Wikidata icons to match the icon size and pill style used elsewhere (Available on / Watch Now rows)
Fix: Setup wizard box now sits vertically centered on the page instead of pinned near the top, with the logo and the version/theme footer each floating halfway between the page edge and the box
Fix: Fixed the setup page's height calculation so this centering resolves against the real viewport instead of collapsing to the content's own size
Fix: Enlarged the Plembfin logo on the setup pages
Fix: Moved the "Restore from backup" shortcut out of the footer bar and into the Backup card on the overview step, so the footer only shows the version number and theme toggle
